transcriptSegments.text: Open your calendar and add three recording slots for the week. Save the plan where you will see it every morning.
Check the plan on Friday and carry anything unfinished into next week instead of dropping it.
Today I plan a whole week of content in one sitting. Write down every question your audience asked you this week.
Write the first sentence of each video before anything else. Make sure the opening answers the question in the title.
Group those questions into three themes. Choose one video idea for each theme.

skillProposals.name: Your calendar and add three recording slots for the week workflow
skillProposals.teaches: How to plan a week of content in one sitting.
candidateSteps: Open your calendar and add three recording slots for the week.
Save the plan where you will see it every morning.
Check the plan on Friday and carry anything unfinished into next week…
Write down every question your audience asked you this week.
Write the first sentence of each video before anything else.
Group those questions into three themes.
Choose one video idea for each theme.
